function: field parsers after the upower -i loop, and the wattage rounding awk
hot_path: Power panel refresh, every 5s while the panel is open, via omarchy-battery-status --shell. The output is displayed. Not a bar tick or a keypress.
why_hot: The same timer that starts the unused top probe. This one fills the battery rows.
stubs: upower is a bash stub copied from test/shell.d/battery-status-test.sh (mouse battery, then macsmc-battery). It returns immediately. Real upower D-Bus was not measured.
sysfs is a temp directory of power_now, charge thresholds and cycle_count, via OMARCHY_POWER_SUPPLY_PATH.
pairing: alternating baseline and patched so load is shared
bench_sh_note: One 8-pair bench.sh run immediately after the top timings had a single patched sample at 46ms and the sets overlapped. The median delta was still about 13ms.

tests.target: patched script, same assertions, ROOT still this checkout

avoided.open_prs: First page of open omacom/omarchy PR titles on 2026-11-11 did not mention battery-status. Per-file diffs were not re-fetched after API credentials failed.

dhh_acceptance: Unlikely. The saving clears 10ms and the noise band on a stubbed upower, but the panel polls every 5s and a real upower call was not in the measurement. The diff rewrites a parser. Prefer the unread top probe.
